ci.gateLabel: fmt, clippy, unit and integration tests, rustdoc
handoffSummary: - ✅ CI is green (`cargo fmt --check`, clippy over every target with warnings
denied, the workspace's unit, doc and generated-code freshness tests, the
`yorkie` rustdoc build with warnings denied, and the `yorkie` crate's
integration tests and quickstart example against a real Yorkie server) for
this exact head SHA, on a PR based on the default branch — and the branch
changes none of the paths that define what CI does (the workflows, the
configuration), so the CI definition that run executed came from `main`

review.sharedPrimitivesNote:
This
  repo layers yorkie → yorkie-client → yorkie-protocol → yorkie-core
  (`docs/dependency-boundaries.md`), and the shared primitives live in
  `crates/yorkie-core/src/` (`crdt/`, `json/`, `time/`, `change/`, `operation/`).

fixer.verifyDescription: `cargo fmt --all --check`, clippy over every target with warnings denied, `cargo test --workspace` and the rustdoc build of the `yorkie` crate with warnings denied
fixer.verifyFailureHint: It builds every dependency from nothing, which takes a few minutes: run it in the foreground and let it finish. If the format check fails, run `cargo fmt --all` rather than reformatting by hand. If `protogen_output_is_up_to_date` fails, regenerate with `cargo run -p protogen`.
fixer.integrationWarning: Do NOT start a Yorkie server or set `YORKIE_TEST_RPC_ADDR`: without one the tests in `crates/yorkie/tests/integration_*.rs` return early and pass, so a green run here says nothing about them
fixer.integrationRerunBy: them against a real server in CI's `integration tests` lane
fixer.ciFailureNote: A failure in the `integration tests` lane cannot be reproduced in this job: fix it from the log, and let the push confirm.
fixer.generatedCodeNote: Never hand-edit `crates/yorkie-protocol/src/generated/yorkie.v1.rs`: it is generated from the `.proto` files under `crates/yorkie-protocol/proto/` by `cargo run -p protogen`. Those `.proto` files are copies whose source of truth is the server repository, yorkie-team/yorkie, so change one only to match the server's.
fixer.apiChangeNote: If the issue requires a protocol change the server does not have, say so on the issue and stop rather than working around it.
fixer.keepReproducerAs: Rust has no `it.fails`, so keep the test and put `#[ignore = "still reproduces: <finding>"]` directly under its test attribute, with a comment naming the finding
fixer.disabledTestForms: switches off with `#[ignore]`, `#[should_panic]` or a `#[cfg(...)]` gate
fixer.commitNote: Commit messages follow this repository's convention: a subject of 70 characters or less that starts with a verb, a blank line, a body wrapped at 80. A new test goes inside a top-level `#[cfg(test)] mod` of the file it tests, or in a new `*_tests.rs` file declared by a `#[cfg(test)] mod <name>;` line in its parent module; the scope hook refuses any other change to a Rust file outside the pull request's diff.
fixer.implementVerifyStep: VERIFY WITH `make verify`, in the foreground, once the push in step 4 has landed: the format check, clippy with warnings denied, the workspace tests and the rustdoc build. It builds every dependency from nothing, which takes a few minutes, and it needs no server. Do NOT start a Yorkie server or set `YORKIE_TEST_RPC_ADDR`: the integration tests return early and pass without one, and the PR's CI runs them against a real server. Fix what it finds, commit and push again. A TARGETED `cargo test -p <crate> <name>` while you work is fine. If you are out of time, skip it and say so in __PR_FILE__: CI runs the same checks.
fixer.lastResortDiagnosis: Re-run the failing lane locally: `make verify` is the whole of the `fmt, clippy, unit tests` lane. The `integration tests` lane needs a Yorkie server, which this job does not have.
